mechanism: Quinidine inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of guanfacine, increasing guanfacine plasma concentrations and enhancing alpha-2 adrenergic effects including hypotension and bradycardia; both drugs also have cardiac effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider dose reduction of guanfacine or alternative antiarrhythmic agent; avoid concurrent use if possible.
